tests.test: Orchard input puts real food in the player's pack
Food input consumes one gathered olive and restores 25 HP
Holding or repeating a food key does not consume repeatedly
Pause rejects food and leaves no delayed consumption
An attack cannot also consume food
Same-frame attack and eating cannot both commit
Food must be in the pack, not a remote cart
Simultaneous mount and food preserves exclusive ownership
Food transaction is complete before notifications and rejects recursion
A busy inventory rolls back attempted healing without losing food
Save restore preserves consumed food and resulting health
Food cannot revive a dead player
